# Personal Log (Excerpt) - 2148
**Author**: Dr. Elara Cole

...
**Log entry #402**
I don't understand. Why are people on my research team hearing whispers that don't exist?
Just last week the reactor ran a full-load test meant to validate the "Void Resonance Theory". To reach that damned output, we added undiluted **StarQuartz** to the core.

**Log entry #403**
Radiation readings are normal, but some "thing" has seeped into our lab. Two more engineers were taken to the infirmary today with severe hallucinations. Is this the invisible side effect of high-purity StarQuartz catalysis?

**Log entry #404**
I have submitted an emergency memo to the board of the SkyVault Consortium. I recommended halting all engine experiments at once and locking down every prototype until StarQuartz's neural interference effect is resolved.

They refused. They said that as long as the test subjects' death rate stays under 15%, the project remains the top priority.
They don't care at all.
